items.quote: And he stayed yet other seven days
items.claim: Noah waited for seven additional days

items.quote: And again he sent forth the dove out of the ark
items.claim: Noah released the dove from the ark a second time

items.quote: And the dove came in to him in the evening
items.claim: The dove returned to Noah in the evening

items.quote: in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off
items.claim: An olive leaf was found in the dove's mouth

items.quote: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth
items.claim: Noah inferred that the floodwaters had receded from the earth
